name: Belt Squat
steps: Secure the dipping belt low around your hips, clip into the machine carriage, and stand with feet shoulder-width apart on the platforms.
Stand tall to unhook the lever arm, brace your core, and hold the front support handles lightly for balance.
Squat smoothly down by bending your hips and knees until your thighs reach at least parallel to the floor.
Drive evenly through both feet to stand tall again and squeeze your glutes and quads at the top.
tips: Use the support handles only for light balance rather than pulling yourself up with your arms.
Keep your torso upright and knees tracking cleanly over your toes throughout each repetition.
